title: Content Studio workflow
purpose: Translate the research into a user-facing workflow.
takeaway: A reviewer can inspect a saved or custom page, score several target queries, generate attributed edits, and export the result.

bullets: Load a saved example or paste an HTML, Markdown, or text snapshot.
Inspect blocks, chunks, source statements, metadata, and per-query scores.
Review attributed edits, score changes, regressions, and exported Markdown.

speaker_notes: The app processes submitted content in memory and never fetches or executes it.
open_questions: Capture a current screenshot after the demo flow is frozen.
